find_package(linux-headers-generic REQUIRED)

add_shared_library(profiling_dynamic_tls)


target_compile_options(profiling_dynamic_tls PRIVATE
  -Wdeprecated-this-capture
  -Wimplicit-fallthrough
  -Wparentheses
  -Wno-logical-op-parentheses
  -Wno-bitwise-op-parentheses
  -Wswitch
  -Wreturn-type
)

target_link_libraries(profiling_dynamic_tls PUBLIC
  linux-headers-generic::linux-headers-generic
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  build-cow-on
  library-profiling-solomon
)

target_link_options(profiling_dynamic_tls PRIVATE
  -Wl,-Bsymbolic
  -ldl
  -lrt
  -Wl,--no-as-needed
  -fPIC
  -Wl,-z,notext
  -fPIC
  -lrt
  -ldl
  -lutil
)

target_sources(profiling_dynamic_tls PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/library/profiling/unittests/dynamic_tls/shared/profiling_dynamic_tls.cpp
)


vcs_info(profiling_dynamic_tls)
